label: chaB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the chaB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor chaB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,477 to 2,556 from dnaA. Read in 535 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying chaB once); 42,800 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.48 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,006 calls, named 98%, 0.19 bits; shell 12,122 calls, named 79%, 1.03 bits; cloud 672 calls, named 27%, 3.74 bits. Outside an RGP 32,858 calls, named 96%, 0.25 bits; inside an RGP 9,942 calls, named 77%, 1.24 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 38 fork, 41 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.24 against 0.25 bits) and names fewer genes (77% against 96%); 9,942 of the 42,800 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 54 (ariR, a fork column) 1.10 bits, RGP 70%; column 53 (ymgC, a variable column) 1.09 bits, RGP 70%; column 52 (pdeG, a fork column) 1.07 bits, RGP 65%. The 13 columns (columns 51-63) where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.81 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 93%, 0.42 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 98%, 0.10 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.48 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 54, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: chaB. named 98%; 0.10 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 8-89%, 60 P, 19 S, RGP 0-81%. named 78-100% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 53, named 78%; most hesitant at column 54, 1.10 bits.
